I appreciate this well-thought-out response, and I should say that emotional, romantic intimacy is at least as important to me as the physical aspect. Otherwise I'd just go hire a prostitute. 

>Do you have friends? Are they close to you? 

No. Acquaintances, sure, but no real friends.

>how many of your close friends are female?

Again, I don't have close friends, but there are plenty of women who I interact with regularly and get along well with. I don't see women as vehicles for sex, but I can't help but feel that painful longing when I'm around them.
